title: Handles catalog item
description: Canonical source-of-truth record for one SKU. See docs/PROJECT_PLAN.md section 4-5.

sku.description: Canonical internal ID, stable across all stores.

price.description: Source-of-truth price in the account's base currency.

quantity.description: Source-of-truth quantity. 0 triggers auto-unlist across all connected stores.

stores.description: One entry per connected *account* this SKU is (or should be) listed on - keyed by account key, not platform, since one platform can have multiple seller accounts (e.g. two eBay stores). See catalog/stores.json for the registered account keys and which platform/adapter each one maps to.

platform.description: Which store adapter handles this account - e.g. 'ebay', 'walmart', 'poshmark'. Multiple accounts can share a platform.

external_offer_id.description: eBay-specific: the published offer tied to the inventory item.

listing_url.description: Direct link to this item's live listing on this account - for a human to open and check/manage themselves. Not used for any automated fetching; Poshmark/Vinted/Mercari have no official API (see docs/API_RESEARCH.md), so this is the deliberately manual alternative to scraping.

last_confirmed_quantity.description: What this store's own listed quantity was the last time reconciliation engine v2 verified a write - the baseline it compares a fresh read against to tell a real sale on this store apart from the source-of-truth quantity simply not having been pushed yet. Absent for a listing that's never been through a v2 write-then-verify.
